denominator.definition: Primary (non-chained) .pdata RUNTIME_FUNCTION entries whose start lies in the main .text section. Every unit the image's own exception data describes counts, including compiler-generated funclets and library code, because encrypted bodies prevent finer classification. Leaf functions without .pdata entries are not counted.
